newsitem.title: USA: First Sierra buys Public Funding Corp asset.
newsitem.headline: First Sierra buys Public Funding Corp asset.

text.p: First Sierra Financial Inc said Monday it acquired certain limited assets of Public Funding Corp of Chicago.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
First Sierra Financial said this is its seventh acquisition since July, 1996.
Public Funding Corp, headquartered in Chicago, is an 18-year-old lease company. It specializes in providing equipment lease financing to state, local and federal government departments and agencies.
First Sierra Financial is a financial services and asset management company.
